summary: 烛影斧声继位留疑案，灭北汉、收吴越统一版图，而高梁河之败创下北伐阴影。
summary_en: Succeeding his brother amid the disputed "candle-shade" mystery, he conquered Northern Han and absorbed Wuyue, but the Gaoliang River defeat cast a long shadow over northern campaigns.

timeline.title: 生
timeline.summary: 太祖弟，初名匡义，继位后改名炅。
timeline.summary_en: Younger brother of Taizu, first named Kuangyi, later renamed Jiong.

timeline.title: 即位
timeline.summary: 太祖崩，光义即位，改元太平兴国；继位与太祖之死的关联是争议层。
timeline.summary_en: He ascended after Taizu died and changed the era to Taiping Xingguo; the link between his accession and his brother's death remains disputed.

timeline.title: 烛影斧声
timeline.summary: 太祖暴崩之夜传闻，史无定谳，归为争议层不坐实。
timeline.summary_en: The night rumors around Taizu's sudden death are unverified; treated as disputed rather than asserted.

timeline.title: 高梁河之败
timeline.summary: 亲征北伐，败于辽，帝中箭乘驴车遁，为宋辽战局转折。
timeline.summary_en: His personal campaign north failed against Liao; the emperor fled wounded in a cart, a turning point in Song-Liao relations.

timeline.title: 灭北汉
timeline.summary: 亲征克太原，北汉亡，五代十国割据至此终结。
timeline.summary_en: He took Taiyuan in person; Northern Han fell, ending the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms era.

timeline.title: 雍熙北伐
timeline.summary: 三路伐辽，曹彬岐沟关大败，雍熙北伐失利。
timeline.summary_en: A three-pronged campaign failed when Cao Bin was routed at Qigou Pass.

timeline.title: 太宗崩
timeline.summary_en: Died at Kaifeng; succeeded by Zhenzong.

timeline.title: 太宗总评
timeline.summary: 勤于政务而猜忌深，兄终弟及与烛影斧声使传位疑案不绝。
timeline.summary_en: Diligent yet suspicious; his brother-to-brother succession kept the throne mystery alive.

relations.note: 太祖弟，继位即帝，金匮之盟为争议层
relations.note_en: Younger brother of Taizu; succeeds to the throne, with the Golden Coffer Pact a disputed layer

relations.note: 至道三年崩，第三子恒即位
relations.note_en: Dies in the 3rd year of Zhidao; his third son Heng takes the throne

relations.note: 辽圣宗在位时宋辽交兵，高梁河、雍熙皆败
relations.note_en: During Emperor Shengzong of Liao's reign, Song and Liao go to war; Gaoliang River and Yongxi both end in defeat

bio_md:
# 宋太宗 · 主要事迹

赵光义是[[n-song-tai-zu|宋太祖]]之弟，开宝九年（976）太祖猝崩后继位，改元太平兴国。兄弟相传在宋史上是极敏感的一环——「烛影斧声」的当夜传闻与「金匮之盟」的杜撰嫌疑历来聚讼，本页只点到，不作坐实。

太宗在位二十一年，最重要的武功是完成统一。太平兴国四年（979）亲征克太原，[[b-han-liu-jun|北汉]]亡，五代十国割据至此终结；同年挥师伐辽，却在高梁河（今北京附近）大败，帝中箭乘驴车遁走，此为宋辽战局之转折。雍熙三年（986）三路伐辽，曹彬岐沟关败绩，北伐之势自此寝息。

内政方面，太宗崇文右儒，重设科举、修纂类书，文官政治进一步定型；但猜忌之心亦重，打压皇弟、贬斥旧僚，兄弟子侄相继远祸。

至道三年（997）太宗崩，第三子赵恒即位，是为[[n-song-zhen|真宗]]。

bio_parts_en.value: Zhao Guangyi was the younger brother of

. When Taizu died suddenly in 976 he succeeded, changing the era to Taiping Xingguo. Brother-to-brother succession is one of the most sensitive passages in Song history - the night rumors of the "candle shadow and the axe sound" and the suspicious "Golden Coffer Pact" remain disputed; this page mentions them without asserting them.

Taizong's chief military achievement was completing unification. In 979 he campaigned in person, took Taiyuan, and destroyed

, ending the era of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms. That same year he pressed north against Liao and suffered a disastrous defeat at the Gaoliang River near modern Beijing, fleeing wounded by cart - a turning point in Song-Liao relations. In 986 a three-pronged campaign failed when Cao Bin was routed at Qigou Pass; northern expansion never recovered.

In domestic politics he exalted letters, expanded the examinations, and compiled the great encyclopedias, cementing civil-bureaucratic rule; but his suspicion was deep, and brothers, sons, and old ministers were pushed aside in turn.
